rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding enumeration
fused sandhi form combining attainment of powers with the root Kaula; internal sandhi noted but token kept whole

items.question: What constitutes the eightfold attainment identified as the root Kaula?
premises: The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
This teaching is addressed directly to the goddess.
items.inference: The eightfold set culminates in the attainment of powers, which is declared to be the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact referents of all eight elements depend on the preceding verses in the enumeration.
items.plain_english: And these are eight; the attainment of powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
